purpose: Lock the teacher-approved Quick Check selector/build/print presentation while allowing question content to vary by approved I Can/family selection.

student_print.page1_first_field: Name line at the very top; Date may share the top row.
student_print.page1_header: Compact Quick Check title/course/unit + version only.
student_print.page2_header: NONE; page 2 begins with assessment content.
student_print.problem_label: Every problem visibly includes exact I Can code followed by exact I Can statement.
student_print.problem_surfaces: Plain white; no shaded problem cards.
student_print.workspace: Plain white space; no repeated ruled workspace lines.
student_print.separation: Use compact typography and simple divider rules rather than decorative boxes.
student_print.paper_use: Avoid large unused bottom areas; use page space efficiently without crowding.
student_print.graphs: Grid and axes must photocopy clearly. Template CSS may override graph-tool line weights to a darker/heavier print-safe treatment.

per_problem_height.control: slider plus exact numeric input in inches
per_problem_height.scope: source problem/evidence architecture; same height follows that problem across scrambled versions

per_problem_graph_size.control: slider plus exact numeric input; percentage of available problem width is acceptable
per_problem_graph_size.scope: when a source problem contains a graph, graph size is adjustable independently for that source problem and follows it across scrambled versions

per_problem_workspace.control: slider plus exact numeric input in inches
per_problem_workspace.scope: writable workspace is adjustable independently for that source problem and follows it across scrambled versions

screen_only_layout_controls.independent_geometry_rule: Changing graph size must not automatically force workspace to grow, and changing workspace must not automatically force graph size to grow. Overall problem height remains independently adjustable; fit/overflow feedback must reveal incompatible combinations rather than silently clipping content.
screen_only_layout_controls.fit_feedback: Show free-space or overflow indicator for each of the eight pages, labeled A1,A2,B1,B2,C1,C2,D1,D2.
screen_only_layout_controls.persistence: Browser localStorage may retain teacher geometry choices for that HTML.
screen_only_layout_controls.screen_position: On normal desktop widths, controls use a fixed/sticky LEFT sidebar so the page preview begins near the top of the viewport instead of being pushed downward. Narrow screens may stack controls above the preview.
screen_only_layout_controls.visible_layout_version: Show a small teacher-facing layout version label in the control panel (for example, Layout v1.2) and store the same version in HTML metadata so screenshots/current files can be identified quickly.

forbidden: inventing materially different parallel questions merely for anti-copying
versioning.question_number_authority: Printed question number is not evidence authority; lineage JSON maps each printed position back to the source slot/I Can/family.

builder.approved_links: Active section shows direct HTML and PDF links when approved files exist.

qa: one HTML, one 8-page student PDF, one JSON source map only in approved artifact set
no teacher answer-key pages inside the 8-page student PDF
all eight default pages fit with print tolerance
page 2 has no repeated header/name field
no shaded problem cards and no ruled workspace lines
exact I Can code + statement visible for every problem
screen controls are absent from print
graph size and workspace are independently adjustable from overall problem height when applicable
source map remains deterministic after scramble
desktop screen controls sit in a left sidebar so a page preview can begin near the top of the viewport
teacher-facing control panel visibly identifies the layout version and HTML metadata carries the same version
